categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Nedfon Air System Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, research and development, production, and sales of indoor ventilation system products. Its main product lines include fresh air systems and air curtain machines, covering hundreds of series and thousands of models applicable to residential, municipal infrastructure, commercial, and industrial buildings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies such as motor design, impeller and flow path optimization, and control systems. It employs advanced manufacturing techniques including laser welding for air curtain machines and automated logistics for production efficiency. The company also integrates heat recovery technology in fresh air systems to improve energy efficiency and collaborates with universities for R&D.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include real estate developers, construction and installation companies, commercial enterprises, and industrial clients. The products serve diverse markets such as residential buildings, commercial complexes, hospitals, schools, transportation hubs, and hospitality venues. The company also sells through distributors, direct sales, e-commerce, and ODM for overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with strong sales presence in East China, South China, Central China, North China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. It has also expanded into Southeast Asia and Middle Eastern countries including Thailand, South Korea, Hong Kong, Vietnam, the Philippines, and Saudi Arabia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Nedfon Air System Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of ventilation system products. It procures raw materials and components such as steel, plastics, copper wires, electronic parts, and motors from suppliers, and sells finished products to distributors and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in energy-efficient, intelligent, and customized ventilation solutions. It invests in expanding product categories, developing new application scenarios, and enhancing smart features. R&D collaborations with top universities and the establishment of a provincial postdoctoral innovation base support its technology leadership. The company also promotes digital transformation through cloud-based design software and integrated service models.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of fresh air systems and air curtain machines. Sales channels include domestic distributors (buyout model), direct sales to large customers, e-commerce platforms, and ODM exports. The company also earns investment income from financial products but this is non-recurring.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both domestic and foreign brands in the indoor ventilation market. Major competitors include Japanese brands like Panasonic, and domestic players such as Midea. Nedfon is recognized as a leading domestic professional ventilation system manufacturer with strong R&D and production capabilities, holding a significant market share especially in air curtain machines where it is a dominant brand.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 570 million, a 20.44% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 96.2 million, up 130.73%. Total assets reached RMB 1.12 billion, growing 11.51%. The company has shown steady growth with expanding production capacity and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nedfon emphasizes improving indoor air quality and building energy efficiency through intelligent, customized, and integrated ventilation solutions. Its products feature advanced filtration, heat recovery, low noise, and energy-saving technologies. The company’s comprehensive product lines and scenario-based designs enable one-stop solutions, supported by digital cloud design services enhancing customer experience and installation efficiency.
